name: Pyromancer passives modify their named spells through native spell mods (#2425, #1781, #1263, #1112)
contract: All four passives are ADD_PCT_MODIFIER (108) or ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER (107) auras over SpellFamilyName 30 class masks, so Player::ApplySpellMod applies them natively. #2425 Ember Charm 704861: SPELLMOD_CASTING_TIME (10) -16+1 = -15%, mask {0x2,0,0} = Cinderheart 800806 (2000 ms) and Kindle 803819 (2000 ms), so 1700 ms. #1263 Blackrock Mountaineer 707494: SPELLMOD_COOLDOWN (11) flat -30001+1 = -30000 ms, mask {0,0,0x20000000} = Eruption 800103 alone (RecoveryTime 120000), so 90000 ms. #1781 Alexstrasza's Gift 300956: SPELLMOD_DAMAGE (0) +14+1 = +15%, mask {0x40,0x8080,0} = Ember Touch 800818, Echo of Nozdormu 802174 and Flames of Neltharion 801915. #1112 Cinderstorm 706875: SPELLMOD_THREAT (2) -26+1 = -25% and SPELLMOD_CRITICAL_CHANCE (7) +9+1 = +10, both on mask {0,0,0x2000} = every Firefall row (801912 asserted). Every value is read through the spell_modifier metric, which applies the player's native spell mods to a fixed base; a control spell outside each mask (Blaze 805500, Cinderheart 800806) must stay unchanged. Regression guard for behaviour that already works natively.
